async function ensurePluginMount() {
  const report = {
    pluginDir: null,
    profiles: [],
    declared: [],
    linked: [],
    removedLegacyLink: [],
    errors: [],
  };
  let realNM = null;
  try {
    realNM = await realpath(PROFILE_NODE_MODULES);
  } catch {
    report.skipped = "profiles/node_modules missing";
    return report;
  }
  const pluginDir = join(realNM, SELF);
  const selfPkg = await readJsonFile(join(pluginDir, "package.json"));
  if (!selfPkg) {
    report.skipped = `${SELF} is not installed in ${realNM}`;
    return report;
  }
  report.pluginDir = pluginDir;

  
  
  const spec = derivePersistedSpec(null, selfPkg.version, null) || `^${selfPkg.version}`;
  const profiles = await listProfileDirs();
  if (!profiles.length) report.skipped = "no profile with a package.json";

  for (const p of profiles) {
    const entry = { profile: p.name, linked: false, declared: false };
    report.profiles.push(entry);

    const linkPath = join(p.dir, "node_modules", SELF);
    try {
      const r = await linkPackageIntoProfile(pluginDir, linkPath, SELF, { expectedName: SELF });
      if (!r.ok) {
        entry.error = r.error;
        report.errors.push({ profile: p.name, step: "link", error: r.error });
      } else {
        entry.linked = true;
        if (r.replaced) {
          entry.replaced = r.replaced;
          report.linked.push({ profile: p.name, replaced: r.replaced });
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      const msg = String((err && err.message) || err);
      entry.error = msg;
      report.errors.push({ profile: p.name, step: "link", error: msg });
    }

    if (p.isHarnessProfile) {
      
      
      
      
      const section = declaredSection(p.pkg, SELF);
      const current = (p.pkg[section] && p.pkg[section][SELF]) || null;
      if (typeof current === "string") {
        entry.declared = true;
        entry.section = section;
        if (!/^[\^~]/.test(current.trim())) entry.foreignDecl = current;
      } else {
        try {
          p.pkg[section] = { ...(p.pkg[section] || {}), [SELF]: spec };
          await writeFile(
            join(p.dir, "package.json"),
            JSON.stringify(p.pkg, null, 2) + "\n",
            "utf8"
          );
          entry.declared = true;
          entry.added = true;
          entry.section = section;
          report.declared.push({ profile: p.name, spec, section });
        } catch (err) {
          const msg = String((err && err.message) || err);
          entry.error = msg;
          report.errors.push({ profile: p.name, step: "declare", error: msg });
        }
      }
    } else {
      entry.declared = false;
      entry.notAProfile = true;
    }
  }

  
  
  const legacy = join(PROFILE_NODE_MODULES, SELF);
  try {
    const st = await lstat(legacy);
    if (st.isSymbolicLink()) {
      const rp = await realpath(legacy).catch(() => null);
      const pluginReal = await realpath(pluginDir).catch(() => null);
      if (rp && pluginReal && rp !== pluginReal) {
        await rm(legacy, { recursive: false, force: true });
        report.removedLegacyLink.push(legacy);
      }
    }
  } catch {
    
  }

  if (report.linked.length || report.declared.length || report.removedLegacyLink.length) {
    await opsLog({
      op: "plugin-self-mount",
      pluginDir,
      linked: report.linked,
      declared: report.declared,
      removedLegacyLink: report.removedLegacyLink,
      errors: report.errors,
    });
  }
  report.ok = report.errors.length === 0;
  return report;
}

function findPnpmInPath() {
  const isWin = process.platform === "win32";
  const exts = isWin ? [".cmd", ".exe", ".bat"] : [""];
  const dirs = String(process.env.PATH || "").split(delimiter).filter(Boolean);
  for (const dir of dirs) {
    for (const ext of exts) {
      const shim = join(dir, "pnpm" + ext);
      if (!existsSync(shim)) continue;
      if (isWin && ext === ".cmd") {
        const real = join(dir, "node_modules", "pnpm", "bin", "pnpm.cjs");
        if (existsSync(real)) return { cmd: real, viaNode: true, corepack: false };
      }
      return { cmd: shim, viaNode: false, corepack: false };
    }
  }
  return null;
}

function findPnpm() {
  if (process.env.DSH_UC_PNPM_BIN) {
    if (process.env.DSH_UC_PNPM_BIN === "__none__") return null;
    return {
      cmd: process.env.DSH_UC_PNPM_BIN,
      viaNode: /\.(?:m|c)?js$/i.test(process.env.DSH_UC_PNPM_BIN),
      corepack: false,
    };
  }
  const bundled = desktopPackageManager();
  if (bundled) return { cmd: bundled.pnpmEntry, viaNode: true, corepack: false, electronNode: true };
  for (const c of pnpmCandidates(dirname(resolveNodeExe()), safeGetNpmCli())) {

}

async function runPnpm(args, opts = {}) {
  const found = findPnpm();
  if (!found) throw Object.assign(new Error("pnpm not found"), { code: "ENOPNPM" });
  const attempts = [found];
  if (found.electronNode) {
    const fallback =
      pnpmCandidates(dirname(resolveNodeExe()), safeGetNpmCli()).find((c) => {
        try {
          return existsSync(c.cmd);
        } catch {
          return false;
        }
      }) || findPnpmInPath();
    if (fallback && fallback.cmd !== found.cmd) attempts.push(fallback);
  }
  let lastError = null;
  for (const candidate of attempts) {
    const pm = candidate.electronNode ? desktopPackageManager() : null;
    const argv = candidate.corepack ? ["pnpm", ...args] : args;
    const exe = candidate.viaNode ? (pm ? pm.nodeExe : resolveNodeExe()) : null;
    const exeArgs = candidate.viaNode
      ? pm
        ? ["--expose-internals", candidate.cmd, ...argv]
        : [candidate.cmd, ...argv]
      : [candidate.cmd, ...argv];
    const cmd = exe
      ? `"${exe}" ${exeArgs.map((a) => `"${a}"`).join(" ")}`
      : exeArgs.map((a) => `"${a}"`).join(" ");
    try {
      return await execP(cmd, {
        cwd: opts.cwd,
        timeout: opts.timeout || 600000,
        maxBuffer: opts.maxBuffer || 8 * 1024 * 1024,
        windowsHide: true,
        env: pm ? { ...process.env, ...pm.env } : process.env,
      });
    } catch (err) {
      lastError = err;
    }
  }
  throw lastError;
}

async function persistPluginSpec(name, targetDir, newSpec) {
  const profiles = await findDeclaringProfiles(name, targetDir);
  const manifest = [];
  for (const dir of profiles) {
    try {
      const manifestPath = join(dir, "package.json");
      const pkg = JSON.parse(await readFile(manifestPath, "utf8"));
      const section = declaredSection(pkg, name);
      const deps = pkg[section] || {};
      const oldSpec = deps[name];
      if (oldSpec === newSpec) {
        manifest.push({ profile: dir, changed: false, spec: newSpec });
        continue;
      }
      deps[name] = newSpec;
      pkg[section] = deps;
      await writeFile(manifestPath, JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2) + "\n", "utf8");
      manifest.push({ profile: dir, changed: true, oldSpec: oldSpec || null, spec: newSpec });
    } catch (err) {
      manifest.push({
        profile: dir,
        changed: false,
        error: truncate(String((err && err.message) || err), 1000),
      });
    }
  }
  const lockfile = [];
  for (const dir of profiles) lockfile.push(await syncLockfile(dir));
  return { manifest, lockfile };
}


async function persistPluginUpdate({ name, newVersion, targetDir, gh }) {
  const profiles = await findDeclaringProfiles(name, targetDir);
  const manifest = [];
  for (const dir of profiles) {
    try {
      const manifestPath = join(dir, "package.json");
      const pkg = JSON.parse(await readFile(manifestPath, "utf8"));
      const section = declaredSection(pkg, name);
      const oldSpec = pkg[section] && pkg[section][name];
      const newSpec = derivePersistedSpec(oldSpec, newVersion, gh);
      if (!newSpec) {
        manifest.push({ profile: dir, changed: false, spec: null, reason: "not-derivable" });
        continue;
      }
      if (newSpec === oldSpec) {
        manifest.push({ profile: dir, changed: false, spec: newSpec });
        continue;
      }
      pkg[section] = pkg[section] || {};
      pkg[section][name] = newSpec;
      await writeFile(manifestPath, JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2) + "\n", "utf8");
      manifest.push({ profile: dir, changed: true, oldSpec: oldSpec || null, spec: newSpec });
    } catch (err) {
      manifest.push({
        profile: dir,
        changed: false,
        error: truncate(String((err && err.message) || err), 1000),
      });
    }
  }
  const lockfile = [];
  for (const dir of profiles) lockfile.push(await syncLockfile(dir));
  return { manifest, lockfile };
}

async function updatePluginFromGitHub(target, tag, version) {
  const tmp = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), "dsh-update-checker-gh-"));
  try {
    const url = `https://codeload.github.com/${target.ghRepo}/tar.gz/${encodeURIComponent(tag)}`;
    
    
    
    let r;
    try {
      r = await ghRequest(url, {
        maxBytes: MAX_TARBALL_BYTES,
        headers: { accept: "application/octet-stream" },
      });
    } catch (err) {
      if (err && err.code === "ETOOBIG") throw err;
      throw Object.assign(
        new Error(`GitHub download failed: ${(err && err.message) || err}`),
        { code: "EDOWNLOAD" }
      );
    }
    if (r.status !== 200) {
      throw Object.assign(new Error(`GitHub download HTTP ${r.status}`), { code: "EDOWNLOAD" });
    }
    let pkgRoot;
    try {
      pkgRoot = extractTarGzToDir(r.buf, tmp);
    } catch (err) {
      throw Object.assign(
        new Error(`GitHub tarball corrupt: ${(err && err.message) || err}`),
        { code: "EDOWNLOAD" }
      );
    }
    const pkg = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(pkgRoot, "package.json"), "utf8"));
    const entry = resolveEntryFile(pkg);
    if (entry && !(await exists(join(pkgRoot, entry)))) {
      throw Object.assign(
        new Error(
          `GitHub repo ${target.ghRepo}@${tag} has no built artifact '${entry}' (source-only repo?) — refusing to replace the installed plugin`
        ),
        { code: "ENOBUILD" }
      );
    }
    if (pkg.version && version && compareVersions(pkg.version, version) !== 0) {
      throw Object.assign(
        new Error(
          `GitHub tag ${tag} (semver ${version}) does not match package.json version ${pkg.version}`
        ),
        { code: "ETAGMISMATCH" }
      );
    }
    
    const { stdout, stderr } = await runStagingInstall({
      npmArgs: buildStageInstallArgs(pkgRoot),
      pnpmArgs: buildPnpmStageInstallArgs(pkgRoot),
      cwd: pkgRoot,
    });
    const allowScripts = await ensureScriptsBuilt(pkgRoot, null);
    const npmOutput = truncate((stdout || "") + (stderr || ""), 2000);
    return await finalizePluginInstall(
      target,
      pkgRoot,
      join(pkgRoot, "node_modules"),
      { source: "github", npmOutput, allowScripts, ghTag: tag },
      filterNoNodeModules
    );
  } finally {
    await rm(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true }).catch(() => {});
  }
}

function isGhFallbackable(err) {
  return !!err && ["ENOBUILD", "ETAGMISMATCH", "ETOOBIG", "EDOWNLOAD", "ENOENT", "ENOPKG"].includes(err.code);
}

function guardPluginUpdate(name, installed, probe) {
  if (!probe || !probe.latest || !installed) return { refuse: false };
  const cmp = compareVersions(probe.latest, installed);
  if (cmp >= 0) return { refuse: false };
  const source = probe.targetSource || probe.source || "unknown";
  const reason = probe.ghError
    ? `GitHub 探测失败（${probe.ghError}），回退到的 npm 版本更旧`
    : `可用更新源（${source}）给出的版本更旧`;
  return {
    refuse: true,
    code: "ENODOWNGRADE",
    name,
    installed,
    planned: probe.latest,
    targetSource: source,
    npmLatest: probe.npmLatest || null,
    ghLatest: probe.ghLatest || null,
    ghError: probe.ghError || null,
    reason,
    message:
      `已阻止降级：${name} 当前安装 ${installed}，而本次探测只给出 ${probe.latest}（${reason}）。` +
      `为避免回退到旧版，本次更新未执行；GitHub 限流通常几分钟后恢复，请稍后重试，或在 profile 中把该插件改到目标 tag 后手动安装。`,
  };
}

async function updatePlugin(name) {
  const installed = await scanInstalledPlugins();
  const target = installed.find((p) => p.name === name);
  if (!target || !target.dir) {
    throw Object.assign(new Error(`plugin not installed or not updatable: ${name}`), {
      code: "EINVALID",
    });
  }
  const probe = await checkPlugin(target, true);
  if (!probe.latest) {
    throw Object.assign(new Error(`no update source for ${name}: ${probe.error || "unknown"}`), {
      code: "ENOSOURCE",
    });
  }
  const installedVersion = probe.installed || target.installed || null;
  const downgrade = guardPluginUpdate(name, installedVersion, probe);
  if (downgrade.refuse) {
    await opsLog({
      op: "plugin-update-refused",
      name,
      code: downgrade.code,
      installed: downgrade.installed,
      planned: downgrade.planned,
      targetSource: downgrade.targetSource,
      npmLatest: downgrade.npmLatest,
      ghLatest: downgrade.ghLatest,
      ghError: downgrade.ghError,
      reason: downgrade.reason,
    });
    const err = new Error(downgrade.message);
    err.code = downgrade.code;
    err.detail = downgrade;
    throw err;
  }
  
  if (probe.targetSource === "github" && probe.ghTag) {
    try {
      const result = await updatePluginFromGitHub(target, probe.ghTag, probe.latest);
      return {
        ...result,
        planned: probe.latest,
        installedBefore: installedVersion,
        targetSource: "github",
        ghTag: probe.ghTag,
        ghError: probe.ghError || null,
      };
    } catch (err) {
      
      
      
      
      
      
      const smartFallback = probe.tie === true && probe.downloadSource === "smart";
      const fallbackable = smartFallback || isGhFallbackable(err);
      const fallbackKeepsVersion = !installedVersion || !probe.npmLatest || compareVersions(probe.npmLatest, installedVersion) > 0;
      if (fallbackable && probe.onNpm && probe.npmLatest && !fallbackKeepsVersion) {
        await opsLog({
          op: "plugin-update-fallback-blocked",
          name,
          installed: installedVersion,
          npmLatest: probe.npmLatest,
          reason: String((err && err.message) || err),
          note: "npm fallback would downgrade the installed plugin",
        });
        err.message = `${err.message} — npm 回退候选 ${probe.npmLatest} 低于已安装的 ${installedVersion}，已放弃回退以避免降级`;
      }
      if (fallbackable && probe.onNpm && probe.npmLatest && fallbackKeepsVersion) {
        await opsLog({
          op: "plugin-update-fallback",
          name,
          from: probe.installed || null,
          to: probe.npmLatest,
          reason: String((err && err.message) || err),
          code: err && err.code,
          mode: smartFallback ? "smart" : "gh-fallbackable",
        });
        const result = await updatePluginFromNpm(target, probe.npmLatest);
        return {
          ...result,
          planned: probe.npmLatest,
          installedBefore: installedVersion,
          targetSource: "npm",
          ghTag: null,
          ghError: probe.ghError || null,
        };
      }
      throw err;
    }
  }
  const result = await updatePluginFromNpm(target, probe.latest);
  return {
    ...result,
    planned: probe.latest,
    installedBefore: installedVersion,
    targetSource: "npm",
    ghTag: probe.ghTag || null,
    ghError: probe.ghError || null,
  };
}

async function rollbackMain() {
  const root = await findDeployRoot();
  if (!root) throw Object.assign(new Error("deployment root not found"), { code: "ENOENT" });
  const backups = await listMainBackups();
  if (!backups.length) {
    throw Object.assign(new Error("no main-program backup found"), { code: "ENOBACKUP" });
  }
  const target = backups[0];
  if (!target.installed) {
    throw Object.assign(
      new Error(`backup ${target.id} is missing the recorded installed version`),
      { code: "ENOBACKUP" }
    );
  }
  const spec = `${PACKAGE}@${target.installed}`;
  await dryRunGuard(root, spec, { allowRemove: true }); 
  const safetyBackup = await backupForUpdate(root); 
  const { args, type } = buildNpmInstallArgs(root, spec);
  const { stdout, stderr } = await runNpm(args, { cwd: root, timeout: 600000 });
  const installed = await readInstalledVersion();
  const ok = installed && target.installed && compareVersions(installed, target.installed) === 0;
  const plan = await planSync(root);
  const synced = await runSync(root, plan.todo);
  const failed = synced.filter((s) => !s.ok);
  await writeSuppressUpToDate(false);
  return {
    ok,
    installed,
    expected: target.installed,
    type,
    backup: target.id,
    safetyBackup,
    synced: synced.map((s) => (s.ok ? s.name : `${s.name} (FAILED: ${s.error})`)),
    syncFailed: failed.length,
    output: truncate((stdout || "") + (stderr || ""), 2000),
  };
}

function readJsonBody(req) {
  return new Promise((resolveBody) => {
    let chunks = "";
    let tooLarge = false;
    req.on("data", (c) => {
      if (tooLarge) return; 
      if (chunks.length + c.length > MAX_BODY_BYTES) {
        tooLarge = true;
        return;
      }
      chunks += c;
    });
    req.on("end", () => {
      if (tooLarge) return resolveBody({ tooLarge: true });
      if (!chunks.trim()) return resolveBody({});
      try {
        resolveBody(JSON.parse(chunks));
      } catch {
        resolveBody({ parseError: true });
      }
    });
    req.on("error", () => resolveBody({}));
  });
}

function json(res, status, payload) {
  const body = JSON.stringify(payload);
  res.writeHead(status, {
    "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8",
    "Cache-Control": "no-store",
  });
  res.end(body);
}

function truncate(s, max) {
  const str = s == null ? "" : String(s);
  return str.length <= max ? str : str.slice(0, max) + "\n…(truncated)";
}




function mainUpdatePlatformError(platform = process.platform, caps = null) {
  if (platform === "win32") return null;
  const c = caps || detectPosixUpdateCaps(platform);
  if (c.probe) return null;
  return {
    code: "E_PLATFORM_UNSUPPORTED",
    error:
      "One-click core updates on Linux/macOS need `ss` or `lsof` to find the process listening on the service port, and neither is available on this host. Stop DSH, update it manually, then restart DSH.",
  };
}

function isLoopback(req) {
  const a = req && req.socket && req.socket.remoteAddress;
  return a === "127.0.0.1" || a === "::1" || a === "::ffff:127.0.0.1";
}


async function writeGate(req, res) {
  if (!isLoopback(req)) {
    return { err: json(res, 403, { ok: false, error: "loopback required" }) };
  }
  const body = await readJsonBody(req);
  if (body && body.tooLarge) {
    return { err: json(res, 413, { ok: false, error: "body too large" }) };
  }
  if (body && body.parseError) {
    return { err: json(res, 400, { ok: false, error: "invalid JSON body" }) };
  }
  if (body && body.confirm !== true) {
    return { err: json(res, 400, { ok: false, error: "confirm required" }) };
  }
  return { body };
}
